ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute turns on the one measurement neither side can settle from the record, so it goes to a human reviewer rather than my choosing between your readings. No money moves yet — the disputed SGD 4.50 is held, neither collected nor refunded.

What is agreed. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02732) shows the driver tapped 'arrived' at 17:06:36 and terminated at 17:13:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold on the platform's own record. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02732) shows SGD 4.50 charged, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 1, below the count of 4; 1/81, below the rate of 0.08), and neither profile shows a POL-NS-09(c) or 09(d) trigger — those points are accepted on both sides.

Why the waiting time cannot be decided. POL-NS-01(c) measures the required continuous dwell from the in-geofence GPS fixes, not from the 'arrived' tap. The only artifact that measures it, the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02732), is impaired: the pre-pass fired GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW — a 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 — and LOW_COVERAGE (coverage_pct 80.5), and it carries weight_multiplier 0.39. That gap falls inside the waiting window, which POL-NS-08(b) makes a policy-level impairment, and the finding does not survive the discount.

The rider's reading — longest admitted in-geofence run 145 seconds, a 35-second shortfall against 180 — is correct about the admitted stretches (60 s from 17:06:36, 145 s from 17:10:51). But the driver's reading — a 400-second qualifying run from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 — bridges precisely the unobserved stretch, and POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory covers the pickup road; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, so limb (i) is unavailable and the intervals cannot be added. So whether the driver actually held position continuously for 180 seconds depends entirely on the 17:07:36–17:10:51 stretch the trace did not observe, and the sole artifact that could answer it is the impaired one at 0.39. Under POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) — the sole evidence for the deciding fact impaired — the case cannot be ruled and is escalated; POL-NS-09(a) points the same way, because confidence is capped at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor. The driver's claim that no escalation trigger is engaged therefore fails.

Remaining points. The rider's POL-NS-06 refund route cannot run, because POL-NS-06 refunds only where the effective dwell is affirmatively short, which is not established; and the rider's POL-NS-04 route cannot exonerate, because the chat log holds 0 messages and the absent rider track is neutral under POL-NS-11, not favourable. The driver's SGD 3.60 compensation cannot be paid while chargeability of the fee is undecided.

Open question for the reviewer: did the driver hold position inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup radius continuously for at least 180 seconds across 17:07:36–17:10:51? The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, but the amount stays frozen pending review.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
